name: B10-0088/2024 (The Left) – Iraq, notably the situation of women’s rights and the recent proposal to amend the Personal Status Law
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Iraq, notably the situation of women’s rights and the recent proposal to amend the Personal Status Law
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion on a proposed change to Iraq's Personal Status Law, which covers marriage, divorce, child custody and inheritance. The Parliament asks Iraq to drop the amendments, set the minimum age of marriage at 18, protect women's and children's rights, and fight violence against women. It also asks the European Union to fund groups that help women and girls in Iraq.

- The report changes nothing in law; it is the Parliament's opinion and request to Iraq.
- It affects women and girls in Iraq, especially those in unregistered marriages.
- Next, the Parliament sends its request to European Union bodies, member states and Iraqi authorities.
